§aFire can't touch you anymore.§f

Starmetal Armor upgrades from Cobalt pieces and gives you 10 defense, 1.0 RR, a hard damage cap of 15, and a 0.5 damage modifier. The whole set is fireproof, so lava, fire, and afterburn are just background noise.

Bismuth Armor is a notable side-grade. Jump Boost, Speed, Regen II, Night Vision, fall damage nullification, and three dashes. It needs Rare Earth, Bismuth Compound, and Gold Wire. Incredible for exploration, but it doesn't upgrade further.

§ePS:§f Starmetal's fire immunity alone makes it worth rushing. Bismuth is great for getting around but won't carry you into endgame.
